---
title: "Hypothesis 3 -  Associations stability"
metadata-files:
  - _quarto.yml
---

# overview

This script addresses **Hypothesis 3**: do bonds formed early in life persist and strengthen across years, and does this differ between pair types? It also assess how temporal pattern can be influenced by demographic context, by comparing two colonies. 

In this analysis, we measured association strength from the entire year (in contrast to H1 and H2). The daughter's first year is therefore excluded from the analysis, since juveniles are marked in late August and do not have a full summer of presence to measure association strength.

Four pair types are compared:

mother-daughter (MD), mother with an unrelated juvenile female,  juvenile-juvenile and all remaining female dyads (other)

The predictor in this analysis is **relationship age**, which is defined:
- MD, M-unrelated juv and juv-juv pairs: daughter age (years since birth year recorded in mother-daughter file)
- all other pairs: years since the pair was first observed together in the data set
  
Pairs in which both individuals were already adults in 2013 are removed, since their true relationship age is unknown.

# 2  Prepare edge lists

# 2.1 function
This add pairID, relation_age and pair type labels to the edge lists
- relation_age for MD pairs = daughter age (years since birth)
- relation_age for other pairs = years since first observed together

Pairs in which both individuals were already adults in 2013 (present in 2013 and not born that year) are removed: their relationship started before the study, so their relationship age is unknown and they may include mother-daughter pairs from before 2013.

Each pair has a single pair type for all years (priority: mother-daughter > mother-unrelated juvenile > juvenile-juvenile > other), so that each pair appears only once per year.

```{r}
prepare_edges <- function(edges_full, md_file, mom_juv, juv_pairs, colony_size_df) {

  # sorted pairID
  df <- edges_full %>%
    mutate(pairID = if_else(from < to,
                            paste(from, to, sep = "-"),
                            paste(to, from, sep = "-")))

  # remove pairs of individuals that were both adults in 2013 (relationship age unknown)
  ind_2013    <- unique(c(df$from[df$year == 2013], df$to[df$year == 2013]))
  adults_2013 <- setdiff(ind_2013, md_file$rfid_off[md_file$year == 2013])
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!(from %in% adults_2013 & to %in% adults_2013))

  # one pair type per pair
  muj_pairs <- unique(mom_juv$pairID[mom_juv$pair_type_2 == "mother-unrelated-daughter"])
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(pair_origin = case_when(
      pairID %in% md_file$pairID   ~ "mother-daughter",
      pairID %in% muj_pairs        ~ "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
      pairID %in% juv_pairs$pairID ~ "juvenile-juvenile",
      TRUE                         ~ "other"
    ))

  # daughter age for MD pairs
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      first_year_md = md_file$year[match(pairID, md_file$pairID)],
      daughter_age  = if_else(
        is.na(first_year_md), NA_real_, as.numeric(year - first_year_md + 1)
      )
    )

  # relation age variable
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(pairID) %>%
    mutate(first_year_overall = min(year)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(relation_age = if_else(
      pair_origin == "mother-daughter",
      daughter_age,
      as.numeric(year - first_year_overall + 1)
    ))

  # remove first summer of early-life pairs (juveniles marked in August)
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!(pair_origin %in% c("mother-daughter",
                               "juvenile-juvenile",
                               "mother-unrelated-juvenile") &
           relation_age == 1))

  # each pair only once per year
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df[, c("pairID", "year")]))

  # colony size
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(colony_size_df, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(colony_size_c = as.numeric(
      scale(colony_size, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
    ))

  # beta transformation, after all filtering
  n <- nrow(df)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(weight_beta = (weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n)

  # factor levels and centre relation_age
  df %>%
    mutate(
      pair_origin = factor(pair_origin,
                           levels = c("other",
                                      "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                                      "juvenile-juvenile",
                                      "mother-daughter")),
      relation_age_c = relation_age - mean(relation_age, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

```

# 2.3 check
Number of pairs per pair type, and number of pairs removed (both individuals adults in 2013)
```{r}
count_pairs <- function(edges_full, edges_final) {
  all_pairs <- edges_full %>%
    mutate(pairID = if_else(from < to, paste(from, to, sep = "-"), paste(to, from, sep = "-")))
  list(
    pairs_total   = n_distinct(all_pairs$pairID),
    pairs_kept    = n_distinct(edges_final$pairID),
    pairs_by_type = edges_final %>% distinct(pairID, pair_origin) %>% count(pair_origin)
  )
}

count_pairs(edges_GB2_full, edges_GB2_final)
count_pairs(edges_UA_full,  edges_UA_final)
```

```{r}

edges_UA_final %>%  summarise(max_ra = max(relation_age, na.rm = TRUE),
```

### 3.0 model
Main-effects models
```{r}
model_age_GB2 <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ relation_age_c + pair_origin + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_GB2_final,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_age_UA <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ relation_age_c + pair_origin + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_UA_final,
  family = beta_family()
)
```

Interaction models
```{r}
model_age_int_GB2 <- glmmTMB(
   weight_beta ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_GB2_final,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_age_int_UA <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_UA_final,
  family = beta_family()
)
```

Summaries
```{r}
summary(model_age_GB2)
summary(model_age_UA)
summary(model_age_int_GB2)
summary(model_age_int_UA)
```

# 3.1 - merged model

Prepare the merged edge list 
```{r}
#put both edge list together 
edges_merged <- bind_rows(
  edges_GB2_final %>% mutate(colony = "GB2"),
  edges_UA_final  %>% mutate(colony = "UA")) %>%
  mutate(colony = factor(colony, levels = c("GB2", "UA")))

#recenter colony_size for both 
edges_merged <- edges_merged %>%
  mutate(colony_size_c = as.numeric(
    scale(colony_size, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  )) %>% 
  mutate(relation_age_c = relation_age - mean(relation_age, na.rm = TRUE))

#recompoute the weight 
n <- nrow(edges_merged)
edges_merged <- edges_merged %>%
  mutate(weight_beta = (weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n)
```

MODEL
```{r}
model_age_merged <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ relation_age_c + pair_origin + colony + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_merged,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_age_int_merged <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin  + colony +  (1| pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_merged,
  family = beta_family()
)
```

```{r}
summary(model_age_merged);summary(model_age_int_merged)
```

```{r diagnostics}
# - check 1: correlation between year and colony size
cor.test(edges_GB2_final$year, edges_GB2_final$colony_size)
cor.test(edges_UA_final$year,  edges_UA_final$colony_size)

cor.test(edges_merged$year, edges_merged$colony_size)

# - check 2: correlation between relation_age and colony size
cor.test(edges_GB2_final$relation_age, edges_GB2_final$colony_size)
cor.test(edges_UA_final$relation_age,  edges_UA_final$colony_size)

cor.test(edges_merged$relation_age, edges_merged$colony_size)

# - check 3: correlation between relation_age and year
cor.test(edges_GB2_final$relation_age, edges_GB2_final$year)
cor.test(edges_UA_final$relation_age,  edges_UA_final$year)

cor.test(edges_merged$relation_age, edges_merged$year)

# - check 4: VIF to check multicollinearity in the model
# lm - just to check collinearity among predictors
lm_check_GB2 <- lm(weight_beta ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin,
                    data = edges_GB2_final)

lm_check_UA <- lm(weight_beta ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin,
                   data = edges_UA_final)

lm_check_merged <- lm(weight_beta ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin,
                   data = edges_merged)

car::vif(lm_check_GB2)
car::vif(lm_check_UA)
car::vif(lm_check_merged)

# - check 5: DHARMa residual diagnostics
library(DHARMa)
sim_GB2 <- simulateResiduals(model_age_int_GB2, plot = TRUE)
sim_UA  <- simulateResiduals(model_age_int_UA,  plot = TRUE)


# - check 6: within-dyad slope per pair type (already done but rerun on colony-specific data)
within_dyad_GB2 <- edges_GB2_final %>%
  group_by(pairID, pair_origin) %>%
  filter(n() > 2) %>%
  summarise(slope = coef(lm(weight ~ relation_age))[2],
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pair_origin) %>%
  summarise(mean_slope = mean(slope),
            prop_positive = mean(slope > 0),
            .groups = "drop")

within_dyad_UA <- edges_UA_final %>%
  group_by(pairID, pair_origin) %>%
  filter(n() > 2) %>%
  summarise(slope = coef(lm(weight ~ relation_age))[2],
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pair_origin) %>%
  summarise(mean_slope = mean(slope),
            prop_positive = mean(slope > 0),
            .groups = "drop")

print(within_dyad_GB2)
print(within_dyad_UA)

```

# 5  Permutations 
Node-label permutations: pair types are shuffled among dyads within each year (and colony), and the observed models are refitted on each permuted dataset.

## 5.0 Functions
```{r}
n_perm <- 100 # 1000 for the final results

coef_names <- c(
  "relation_age_c",
  "pair_originmother-unrelated-juvenile",
  "pair_originmother-daughter",
  "pair_originjuvenile-juvenile"
)
coef_names_int <- c(
  coef_names,
  "relation_age_c:pair_originmother-unrelated-juvenile",
  "relation_age_c:pair_originmother-daughter", 
  "relation_age_c:pair_originjuvenile-juvenile"
)
```

#### Permutation function
Refits the main-effects and interaction models on `n_perm` permuted datasets
```{r}
run_permutations <- function(data, formula_main, formula_int, n_perm, groups = "year") {
  perm_main <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(coef_names),     dimnames = list(NULL, coef_names))
  perm_int  <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(coef_names_int), dimnames = list(NULL, coef_names_int))

  for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    d <- data %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(groups))) %>%
      mutate(pair_origin = sample(pair_origin)) %>%
      ungroup()

    m <- glmmTMB(formula_main, family = beta_family(), data = d)
    perm_main[i, ] <- fixef(m)$cond[coef_names]

    m_int <- glmmTMB(formula_int, family = beta_family(), data = d)
    perm_int[i, ] <- fixef(m_int)$cond[coef_names_int]
  }
  list(main = perm_main, int = perm_int)
}
```

#### p-value function
```{r}
#two-tailed permutation p-values
compute_perm_pvalues <- function(obs_coef, perm_matrix) {
  sapply(names(obs_coef), function(nm)
    mean(abs(perm_matrix[, nm]) >= abs(obs_coef[nm]), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

#### Permutation results table
```{r}
make_perm_table <- function(obs_coef, perm_matrix, p_values) {
  data.frame(term = names(obs_coef), observed = as.numeric(obs_coef),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(
      as.data.frame(perm_matrix) %>%
        pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "value") %>%
        group_by(term) %>%
        summarise(perm_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), perm_sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
      by = "term"
    ) %>%
    mutate(p_value = p_values[term]) %>%
    # node-label permutations only test terms involving pair type,
    # the main effect of relationship age is assessed with the model's Wald test
    filter(grepl("pair_origin", term)) %>%
    arrange(desc(observed))
}
```


## 5.1  GB2
```{r perm-gb2}
set.seed(23)
perm_GB2_all <- run_permutations(edges_GB2_final,
                                 formula(model_age_GB2), formula(model_age_int_GB2),
                                 n_perm)
perm_GB2     <- perm_GB2_all$main
perm_int_GB2 <- perm_GB2_all$int

save(perm_GB2, perm_int_GB2,
     file = here("results", "H3_permutations_GB2.RData"))
```

```{r perm-gb2-pvalues}
obs_GB2     <- fixef(model_age_GB2)$cond[coef_names]
obs_int_GB2 <- fixef(model_age_int_GB2)$cond[coef_names_int]

p_GB2     <- compute_perm_pvalues(obs_GB2,     perm_GB2)
p_int_GB2 <- compute_perm_pvalues(obs_int_GB2, perm_int_GB2)

table_GB2     <- make_perm_table(obs_GB2,     perm_GB2,     p_GB2)
table_int_GB2 <- make_perm_table(obs_int_GB2, perm_int_GB2, p_int_GB2)

cat("GB2 main effects ---\n");   print(table_GB2)
cat("\nGB2 interaction ---\n");  print(table_int_GB2)

write.csv(table_GB2,
          here("results", "tables", "H3_perm_GB2_main.csv"),        row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_int_GB2,
          here("results", "tables", "H3_perm_GB2_interaction.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 7  PLOT — model predictions

## GB2 + UA plot
```{r}
pair_colors <- c("mother-daughter" = "#cf67b3",
                  "mother-unrelated-juvenile" = "#3d4f91",
                  "juvenile-juvenile" = "#7c9fd9",
                  "other" = "#999999")
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# prediction grid, integer relationship ages
# uncentre: relation_age_c = relation_age - mean_age
mean_age_GB2 <- mean(edges_GB2_final$relation_age, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_age_UA  <- mean(edges_UA_final$relation_age,  na.rm = TRUE)

# get emmeans at each integer relation_age per pair_origin
emm_GB2 <- emmeans(model_age_int_GB2,
                    ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin,
                    at = list(
                      relation_age_c = seq(1, 10, by = 1) - mean_age_GB2,
                      colony_size_c = 0
                    ),
                    type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(relation_age = relation_age_c + mean_age_GB2,
         colony = "GB2")

emm_UA <- emmeans(model_age_int_UA,
                   ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin,
                   at = list(
                     relation_age_c = seq(1, 9, by = 1) - mean_age_UA,
                     colony_size_c = 0
                   ),
                   type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(relation_age = relation_age_c + mean_age_UA,
         colony = "UA")

emm_all <- bind_rows(emm_GB2, emm_UA) %>%
  rename(SRI = response) %>%
  mutate(pair_origin = factor(pair_origin,
                               levels = c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                                          "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter")),
         colony = factor(colony, levels = c("GB2", "UA")))

# clip at observed max per pair type per colony
max_ages <- bind_rows(
  edges_GB2_final %>% group_by(pair_origin) %>%
    summarise(max_age = max(relation_age), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(colony = "GB2"),
  edges_UA_final %>% group_by(pair_origin) %>%
    summarise(max_age = max(relation_age), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(colony = "UA")
) %>%
  mutate(pair_origin = factor(as.character(pair_origin),
                               levels = c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                                          "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter")))

# raw means per integer year per pair type
raw_means <- bind_rows(
  edges_GB2_final %>% mutate(colony = "GB2"),
  edges_UA_final  %>% mutate(colony = "UA")
) %>%
  mutate(pair_origin = factor(as.character(pair_origin),
                               levels = c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                                          "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter")),
         colony = factor(colony, levels = c("GB2", "UA"))) %>%
  group_by(colony, pair_origin, relation_age) %>%
  summarise(mean_SRI = mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# plot
p <- ggplot() +
  # CI ribbon only
  geom_ribbon(data = emm_all,
              aes(x = relation_age,
                  ymin = asymp.LCL,
                  ymax = asymp.UCL,
                  fill = pair_origin),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  # predicted lines
  geom_line(data = emm_all,
            aes(x = relation_age, y = SRI, color = pair_origin),
            linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ colony, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pair_colors, name = "origin of pair") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pair_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "relationship age (years)",
       y = "association strength (SRI)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13, face = "plain")
  )

p

ggsave(here("results","figures","H3_model_prediction.png"), p, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

#### merged model - plot
```{r}

# mean relation_age for uncentreing
mean_age <- mean(edges_merged$relation_age, na.rm = TRUE)

# predicted means
emm_merged <- emmeans(model_age_int_merged,
                       ~ relation_age_c * pair_origin,
                       at = list(
                         relation_age_c = seq(1, 11, by = 1) - mean_age,
                         colony_size_c  = 0
                       ),
                       type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(SRI = response) %>%
  mutate(relation_age = relation_age_c + mean_age,
         pair_origin  = factor(pair_origin,
                                levels = c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                                           "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter")))

# plot
p <- ggplot(emm_merged,
            aes(x = relation_age, y = SRI,
                color = pair_origin, fill = pair_origin)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
              alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pair_colors, name = "dyad origin") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = pair_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:11) +
  labs(x = "relationship age (years)",
       y = "association strength (SRI)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 13, face = "plain"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

p
ggsave(here("results","figures","H3_merged.png"), p, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```
